scope: Same 26-variable IF/detector/audio/supply MNA without injected IF; actual modeled stage currents with remaining converter substitutes.

faults.label: Switch off at 0.6 s · observe to 1.2 s

numerical_contract.initialization: Zero capacitor voltages and inductor currents; nominal-hot heaters/emission. Not cold thermal startup.
numerical_contract.integrator: Backward Euler at default 1/48000 s, with damped Newton and up to four subdivisions. Signal-node stopping 20 pA, supply-node stopping 1 nA; accepted overall normalized residual <10 nA. Strict 20 fA signal-node comparison and half-step checks bound the reported supply behavior.
numerical_contract.statistics: Final six line-frequency periods, clipped/interpolated at measurement boundary using full-rate states. RMS/ripple/min/max and line-frequency projection.
numerical_contract.display: At most about 2001 samples; displayed points do not determine statistics.
numerical_contract.source: No injected IF current or synthetic detector source. Same source-traced tuning, detector/audio, field and supply network.
numerical_contract.timing_scope: Supply duration_s/dt_s govern the run. The receiver parameter block retains inherited IF arrival/carrier timing defaults; these do not set this idle simulation duration or step.
numerical_contract.dry_reservoir: The 10% reservoir-capacitance fault uses an eight-times finer step (1/384000 s) to resolve narrow charging pulses and near-zero rail crossings against independent SPICE.

limits: 7A8 remains the explicit 30 kohm plate/120 kohm screen substitute load.
Heater resistance, lamp hot resistance, emission versus heater temperature and field inductance remain assumed.
No RF/oscillator operation, cold-heater warmup, historical voltage calibration or full shop benchmark closure.
RCA curve checks remain nominal-heater 5–40 V forward drop; extrapolation and emission-scaled faults are not validated curve behavior.
